text_block_list.text:
Transcend completed her Debut race, though 
her performance wasn't exactly something 
to boast about.

Having rarely been the center of attention 
before, the intense gazes of race fans 
seemed to cause her mind to overflow.

To resolve the issue, the Trainer thought 
about having her gain race experience for 
a while and get used to being the center 
of attention even in her daily life.
